Description

Jenna Miner, The wife of Mike Miner is located next to the Mike Mines Shop, at the main entrance to Mike's Mines. Jenna gives the quest for Michael's Copper Axe.

Trivia

Jenna has some strange Lore surrounding her as she has been missing the Entirety of the Old Oaklands map, Players assumed she was either Missing or Dead according to the voice lines of Mike Miner explaining that he misses her and one day she just disappeared. But she recently returned to the Game when the New map was introduced. When asking her where she was, she would reply with "I don't know what you are talking about silly."

Recently she was rotated to face the Mike Mines Shop and is now floating slightly off the ground .
